answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. To join, a name must pass Diamondbound gem weigher garnet writ, which works because a writ gem weighers sign after assay office audits. Before the stamp comes a deposit of 22 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The tally keeps dawn. The raven is on the docket. falcon stays on the record.
